headlines.description: — Through two games, the Cavaliers have been tough guys in these playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Mitchell scores 23 as Cavaliers power to 96-86 win over Magic and 2-0 lead in series

headlines.description: — An eight-point lead was gone. The Knicks' edge in the series and home-court advantage seemed about to follow. Madison Square Garden had fallen nearly silent.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donte DiVincenzo caps desperate rally with 3-pointer, Knicks beat 76ers 104-101 to take 2-0 lead

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — Jamal Murray didn't even see the biggest basket of his career. At least not live, he didn't.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jamal Murray sinks shot at buzzer to cap 20-point comeback and lead Nuggets past Lakers 101-99
